data.title: Khamenei: IRGC will have 'immediate, unrestricted response' to any threats | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Khamenei ordered the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps to update its target list with the aim of having "all tangible and intangible assets of the US and Israeli within reach of the armed forces."
